transcript: This video was shot entirely on a tripod, and without ever moving the camera, I was able to get all these different camera angles. I can even add motion to the scene by pushing the camera away, pulling it back in. I can even point to an imaginary camera over here, or even get an overhead drone shot like this. All it takes is one angle to get any number of B-roll shots that you want. If you want to learn how to do this, just comment angle, and I'll send you the guide.
caption:
Too lazy to get camera-ready? Don't have a background that looks professional?

 Using Genjutsu, you can swap out the background, character, and anything else... and it actually looks GOOD.

 I took it a step further by generating different camera angles using the transformed footage.
